doc.title: Monthly Updates [July]
doc.html:
INFO These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our Commits Page on GitHub or Updates Channel in Discord.

Wiki Updates

  • Added Platform Icons to descriptions on the website. Note that more sections may get icons in the future where we feel necessary. TY to hugo for this.

  • Started a YouTube Channel Spreadsheet with channels recommended by FMHY users. TY to zink for this.

  • Added a Browser Startpage to our website. If there's anything you guys would like added to it, let us know. TY to tasky for this.

  • Added Tabletop, Chess, Card, Dungeons & Dragons, and RPG Worldbuilding sections.

  • Updated guides: VPN Binding / Windows Debloat / ReVanced Obtainium / webOS Homebrew.

  • Cleaned up Royalty-Free Music, added labels, and moved it from storage to its own section. Before vs. After.

  • Cleaned up Content Removers, merged both sections, and moved them out of storage. Before vs. After.

  • Cleaned up File / P2P Transfer; removed any that were unmaintained or had bad privacy policies. Before vs. After.

  • Cleaned up Regex Tools, Map Creators / Editors, and Tabletop Tool sections.

  • Moved Browser Ebook Readers + Game Assets out of storage into their own sections.

  • Split Job Search / Application sites into their own section under Career.

Stars Added ⭐

  • Starred Acer Movies in Drives / Directories. Big library with single-click downloads.

  • Starred Ascendara in Game Launchers. Open-source, feature-rich game manager with easy in-app downloads.

  • Starred GPT1Image in Image Generators. Free unlimited GPT-Image-1 images.

  • Starred Axekin in ROM sites. Fast hosts, big library, and lots of platforms.

  • Starred NoPayStation in Sony ROMs. One of the best sources for Sony platform ROMs.

  • Starred 1DM in Android Download Managers as it won in polls and has features like split-file support.

  • Starred Metrolist in Android YouTube Music players, as people feel this stands out the most of the Outertune forks.

  • Starred AntiSplit-M in APK Tools. Easily merge split APK files.

  • Starred bleh in Last.fm Tools. Feature-rich customization script that makes the site look much better.

  • Starred PDALife in Modded APKs. Easy download process, fast host, and good for modded games.

  • Starred GamersNexus in Tech News. In-depth component reviews and news for PC building.

  • Starred bt.etree, MiroPPB (ASOT), and BBC Essential in Concert / Live Shows.

  • Starred NovelFire in Light Novels. Nice UI; allows login to rate and save progress.

  • Starred LM Studio in AI Self-Hosting. Useful for running models locally; supports all GPUs or runs on CPU if needed.

  • Starred Tailscale in VPN Tools. Secure Network VPN that's easy to use and very feature-rich.

  • Starred Stop The Bleed in Med School. Free first aid video courses and resources.

Things Removed

  • Unstarred G-MEH as it tends to have outdated plugins, disabled pages, and people feel there are better options.

  • Unstarred SystemRequirementsLab as people don't feel it's very useful anymore.

  • Unstarred Comfy Online as it has older / more limited models than other starred options.

  • Removed Awesome Piracy as it's no longer maintained very well. No disrespect intended - Awesome Piracy is older than FMHY and inspired us in a lot of ways early on; if it starts getting maintained better, we'll consider re-adding it.
